latestVersion.changelog:
- Clarified in documentation that mesh scripts are now "read and insert only"; anon key can no longer UPDATE or DELETE rows.
- Updated security section: RLS policies strictly enforce SELECT and INSERT only, ensuring cleanup is manual via Supabase Dashboard.
- Changed best practice: dedicated Supabase project is now required for mesh operation — do not reuse projects with sensitive data.
- Minor documentation updates to script descriptions for greater clarity.
